description: Read every spatial obligation in the saved game contract (get), or save region/location classifications, hierarchy, entries and intended connections (put). No genre counts. Old contracts need explicit classifications; declared spatial roles cannot be weakened. Regions require real child locations. Construction and verification remain separate. Scope writes use project revision checking. Continue with gripforge_game_world build/journey/test. 0 credits.
